content.text:
**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or stipulated-payment obligation on Clear Capital:

- **§ 3 (Compensation)** — pure time-and-materials with expense reimbursement; no minimum spend/commitment, no late-payment interest or penalty charge.
- **§ 6(a)** — either party may terminate for convenience on 15 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding, with no exit fee.
- **§ 6(b) / § 7(c)** — on termination the Contractor receives only fees and expenses "incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination" — compensatory, not a stipulated sum or minimum-fee-on-termination.
- **§ 5** — on certain terminations Company owes no fees at all (favourable to us).
- **§ 7(a)** — the mutual cap limits, rather than creates, Company-payable damages, so it is not an LD trigger.

This satisfies the **preferred** position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so the fallback (3-month capped early-termination fee) is not needed. One watch-item noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the Statements of Work are incorporated by reference, so any SOW should be checked to confirm it does not introduce a cancellation charge or minimum-hours commitment — if one appears, it should be capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
